description.value: Bonus to the Aid action when helping an ally defend a place or person you consider home — the least specialized set of instincts a person can walk in with, and proof that generalists are exactly what keeps a Free Haven standing.

cinderfall.incomplete: The card states a bonus but gives no numeric value, bonus type, or specific action tag to build a FlatModifier from without inventing one. and 'a place or person you consider home' is a narrative condition with no roll option.
